1.name: Bulbasaur
1.dex: While it is young, it uses the nutrients that are stored in the seeds on its back in order to grow.

2.name: Ivysaur
2.dex: The bulb on its back grows as it absorbs nutrients. The bulb gives off a pleasant aroma when it blooms.

3.name: Venusaur
3.dex: As it warms itself and absorbs the sunlight, its flower petals release a pleasant fragrance.

4.name: Charmander
4.dex: If it's healthy, the flame on the tip of its tail will burn vigorously, even if it gets a bit wet.

5.name: Charmeleon
5.dex: If it becomes agitated during battle, it spouts intense flames, incinerating its surroundings.

6.name: Charizard
6.dex: It uses its wings to fly high. The temperature of its fire increases as it gains experience in battle.

7.name: Squirtle
7.dex: When it feels threatened, it draws its legs inside its shell and sprays water from its mouth.

8.name: Wartortle
8.dex: Its long, furry tail is a symbol of longevity, making it quite popular among older people.

9.name: Blastoise
9.dex: It firmly plants its feet on the ground before shooting water from the jets on its back.

10.name: Caterpie
10.dex: It crawls into foliage where it camouflages itself among leaves that are the same color as its body.

11.name: Metapod
11.dex: This is its preevolved form. At this stage, it can only harden, so it remains motionless to avoid attack.

12.name: Butterfree
12.dex: It flits from flower to flower, collecting honey. It can even identify distant flowers in bloom.

13.name: Weedle
13.dex: The barb on top of its head secretes a strong poison. It uses this toxic barb to protect itself.

14.name: Kakuna
14.dex: Nearly incapable of movement, it leans against stout trees while waiting for its evolution.

15.name: Beedrill
15.dex: It uses sharp, poisonous stings to defeat prey, then takes the victim back to its nest for food.

16.name: Pidgey
16.dex: It rapidly flaps its wings in the grass, stirring up a dust cloud that drives insect prey out into the open.

17.name: Pidgeotto
17.dex: It slowly flies in a circular pattern, all the while keeping a sharp lookout for prey.

18.name: Pidgeot
18.dex: Its outstanding vision allows it to spot splashing MAGIKARP, even while flying at 3300 feet.

19.name: Rattata
19.dex: This Pokémon's impressive vitality allows it to live anywhere. It also multiplies very quickly.

20.name: Raticate
20.dex: The webs on its hind legs enable it to cross rivers. It searches wide areas for food.

21.name: Spearow
21.dex: To protect its territory, it flies around ceaselessly, making highpitched cries.

22.name: Fearow
22.dex: It uses its long beak to attack. It has a surprisingly long reach, so it must be treated with caution.

23.name: Ekans
23.dex: It flutters the tip of its tongue to seek out the scent of prey, then swallows the prey whole.

24.name: Arbok
24.dex: To intimidate foes, it spreads its chest wide and makes eerie sounds by expelling air from its mouth.

25.name: Pikachu
25.dex: When it is angered, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.

26.name: Raichu
26.dex: If its electric pouches run empty, it raises its tail to gather electricity from the atmosphere.

27.name: Sandshrew
27.dex: It prefers dry, sandy places because it uses the sand to protect itself when threatened.

28.name: Sandslash
28.dex: Adept at climbing trees, it rolls into a spiny ball, then attacks its enemies from above.

29.name: Nidoran-F
29.dex: Small and very docile, it protects itself with its small, poisonous horn when attacked.

30.name: Nidorina
30.dex: It has a docile nature. If it is threatened with attack, it raises the barbs that are all over its body.

31.name: Nidoqueen
31.dex: The hard scales that cover its strong body serve as excellent protection from any attack.

32.name: Nidoran-M
32.dex: It constantly moves its large ears in many directions in order to detect danger right away.

33.name: Nidorino
33.dex: It is easily agitated and uses its horn for offense as soon as it notices an attacker.

34.name: Nidoking
34.dex: It uses its thick arms, legs and tail to attack forcefully. Melee combat is its specialty.

35.name: Clefairy
35.dex: Though rarely seen, it becomes easier to spot, for some reason, on the night of a full moon.

36.name: Clefable
36.dex: Said to live in quiet, remote mountains, this type of fairy has a strong aversion to being seen.

37.name: Vulpix
37.dex: As its body grows larger, its six warm tails become more beautiful, with a more luxurious coat of fur.

38.name: Ninetales
38.dex: It is said to live a thousand years, and each of its tails is loaded with supernatural powers.

39.name: Jigglypuff
39.dex: It rolls its cute eyes as it sings a soothing lullaby. Its gentle song puts anyone who hears it to sleep.

40.name: Wigglytuff
40.dex: The rich, fluffy fur that covers its body feels so good that anyone who feels it can't stop touching it.

41.name: Zubat
41.dex: During the day, it gathers with others and hangs from the ceilings of old buildings and caves.

42.name: Golbat
42.dex: When it plunges its fangs into its prey, it instantly draws and gulps down more than ten ounces of blood.

43.name: Oddish
43.dex: During the day, it stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.

44.name: Gloom
44.dex: The smell from its drool-like syrup and the pollen on its petals is so bad, it may make opponents faint.

45.name: Vileplume
45.dex: By shaking its big petals, it scatters toxic pollen into the air, turning the air yellow.

46.name: Paras
46.dex: The tochukaso growing on this Pokémon's back orders it to extract juice from tree trunks.

47.name: Parasect
47.dex: When nothing's left to extract from the bug, the mushrooms on its back leave spores on the bug's egg.

48.name: Venonat
48.dex: The small bugs it eats appear only at night, so it sleeps in a hole in a tree until night falls.

49.name: Venomoth
49.dex: The scales it scatters will paralyze anyone who touches them, making that person unable to stand.

50.name: Diglett
50.dex: It digs underground and chews on tree roots, sticking its head out only when the sun isn't bright.

51.name: Dugtrio
51.dex: These DIGLETT triplets dig over 60 miles below sea level. No one knows what it's like underground.

52.name: Meowth
52.dex: It loves things that sparkle. When it sees a shiny object, the gold coin on its head shines too.

53.name: Persian
53.dex: Behind its lithe, elegant appearance lies a barbaric side. It will tear apart its prey on a mere whim.

54.name: Psyduck
54.dex: The only time it can use its psychic power is when its sleeping brain cells happen to wake.

55.name: Golduck
55.dex: It swims gracefully along on the quiet, slow-moving rivers and lakes of which it is so fond.

56.name: Mankey
56.dex: It lives in groups in the treetops. If it loses sight of its group, it becomes infuriated by its loneliness.

57.name: Primeape
57.dex: It will beat up anyone who makes it mad, even if it has to chase them until the end of the world.

58.name: Growlithe
58.dex: It controls a big territory. If it detects an unknown smell, it roars loudly to force out the intruder.

59.name: Arcanine
59.dex: An ancient picture scroll shows that people were attracted to its movement as it ran through prairies.

60.name: Poliwag
60.dex: The swirl on its belly is its insides showing through the skin. It looks clearer after it eats.

61.name: Poliwhirl
61.dex: Though it is skilled at walking, it prefers to live underwater where there is less danger.

62.name: Poliwrath
62.dex: It can use its well-developed arms and legs to run on the surface of the water for a split second.

63.name: Abra
63.dex: It hypnotizes itself so that it can teleport away when it senses danger, even if it is asleep.

64.name: Kadabra
64.dex: When it closes its eyes, twice as many alpha particles come out of the surface of its body.

65.name: Alakazam
65.dex: It has an IQ of 5000. It calculates many things in order to gain the edge in every battle.

66.name: Machop
66.dex: It trains by lifting rocks in the mountains. It can even pick up a GRAVELER with ease.

67.name: Machoke
67.dex: This tough Pokémon always stays in the zone. Its muscles become thicker after every battle.

68.name: Machamp
68.dex: With four arms that react more quickly than it can think, it can execute many punches at once.

69.name: Bellsprout
69.dex: If it notices anything that moves, it immediately flings its vine at the object.

70.name: Weepinbell
70.dex: When it's hungry, it swings its razor-sharp leaves, slicing up any unlucky object nearby for food.

71.name: Victreebel
71.dex: Once ingested into this Pokémon's body, even the hardest object will melt into nothing.

72.name: Tentacool
72.dex: As it floats along on the waves, it uses its toxic feelers to stab anything it touches.

73.name: Tentacruel
73.dex: When its 80 feelers absorb water, it stretches to become like a net to entangle its prey.

74.name: Geodude
74.dex: Proud of their sturdy bodies, they bash against each other in a contest to prove whose is harder.

75.name: Graveler
75.dex: It travels by rolling on mountain paths. If it gains too much speed, it stops by running into huge rocks.

76.name: Golem
76.dex: Its rock-like body is so durable, even high-powered dynamite blasts fail to scratch its rugged hide.

77.name: Ponyta
77.dex: Training by jumping over grass that grows longer every day has made it a world-class jumper.

78.name: Rapidash
78.dex: It just loves to gallop. The faster it goes, the longer the swaying flames of its mane will become.

79.name: Slowpoke
79.dex: It is always so absent-minded that it won't react, even if its flavorful tail is bitten.

80.name: Slowbro
80.dex: An attached SHELLDER won't let go because of the tasty flavor that oozes out of its tail.

81.name: Magnemite
81.dex: The electricity emitted by the units on each side of its body cause it to become a strong magnet.

82.name: Magneton
82.dex: When many MAGNETON gather together, the resulting magnetic storm disrupts radio waves.

83.name: Farfetch’d
83.dex: In order to prevent their extinction, more people have made an effort to breed these Pokémon.

84.name: Doduo
84.dex: It lives on a grassy plain where it can see a long way. If it sees an enemy, it runs away at 60 mph.

85.name: Dodrio
85.dex: An enemy that takes its eyes off any of the three heads--even for a second--will get pecked severely.

86.name: Seel
86.dex: The light blue fur that covers it keeps it protected against the cold. It loves icebergfilled oceans.

87.name: Dewgong
87.dex: It sleeps under shallow ocean waters during the day, then looks for food at night when it's cold.

88.name: Grimer
88.dex: When two of these Pokémon's bodies are combined together, new poisons are created.

89.name: Muk
89.dex: As it moves, a very strong poison leaks from it, making the ground there barren for three years.

90.name: Shellder
90.dex: Clamping on to an opponent reveals its vulnerable parts, so it uses this move only as a last resort.

91.name: Cloyster
91.dex: Even a missile can't break the spikes it uses to stab opponents. They're even harder than its shell.

92.name: Gastly
92.dex: It wraps its opponent in its gaslike body, slowly weakening its prey by poisoning it through the skin.

93.name: Haunter
93.dex: It hides in the dark, planning to take the life of the next living thing that wanders close by.

94.name: Gengar
94.dex: Hiding in people's shadows at night, it absorbs their heat. The chill it causes makes the victims shake.

95.name: Onix
95.dex: As it digs through the ground, it absorbs many hard objects. This is what makes its body so solid.

96.name: Drowzee
96.dex: When it twitches its nose, it can tell where someone is sleeping and what that person is dreaming about.

97.name: Hypno
97.dex: The longer it swings its pendulum, the longer the effects of its hypnosis last.

98.name: Krabby
98.dex: If it is unable to find food, it will absorb nutrients by swallowing a mouthful of sand.

99.name: Kingler
99.dex: Its oversized claw is very powerful, but when it's not in battle, the claw just gets in the way.

100.name: Voltorb
100.dex: During the study of this Pokémon, it was discovered that its components are not found in nature.

101.name: Electrode
101.dex: The more energy it charges up, the faster it gets. But this also makes it more likely to explode.

102.name: Exeggcute
102.dex: If even one is separated from the group, the energy bond between the six will make them rejoin instantly.

103.name: Exeggutor
103.dex: Living in a good environment makes it grow lots of heads. A head that drops off becomes an EXEGGCUTE.

104.name: Cubone
104.dex: It lost its mother after its birth. It wears its mother's skull, never revealing its true face.

105.name: Marowak
105.dex: Somewhere in the world is a cemetery just for MAROWAK. It gets its bones from those graves.

106.name: Hitmonlee
106.dex: It is also called the Kick Master. It uses its elastic legs to execute every known kick.

107.name: Hitmonchan
107.dex: To increase the strength of all its punch moves, it spins its arms just before making contact.

108.name: Lickitung
108.dex: It has a tongue that is over 6’6’’ long. It uses this long tongue to lick its body clean.

109.name: Koffing
109.dex: If one gets close enough to it when it expels poisonous gas, the gas swirling inside it can be seen.

110.name: Weezing
110.dex: When it inhales poisonous gases from garbage, its body expands, and its insides smell much worse.

111.name: Rhyhorn
111.dex: It can remember only one thing at a time. Once it starts rushing, it forgets why it started.

112.name: Rhydon
112.dex: By lightly spinning its drilllike horn, it can easily shatter even a diamond in the rough.

113.name: Chansey
113.dex: People try to catch it for its extremely nutritious eggs, but it rarely can be found.

114.name: Tangela
114.dex: During battle, it constantly moves the vines that cover its body in order to annoy its opponent.

115.name: Kangaskhan
115.dex: To avoid crushing the baby it carries in its pouch, it always sleeps standing up.

116.name: Horsea
116.dex: When they're in a safe location, they can be seen playfully tangling their tails together.

117.name: Seadra
117.dex: The male raises the young. If it is approached, it uses its toxic spikes to fend off the intruder.

118.name: Goldeen
118.dex: During spawning season, they swim gracefully in the water, searching for their perfect mate.

119.name: Seaking
119.dex: When autumn comes, the males patrol the area around their nests in order to protect their offspring.

120.name: Staryu
120.dex: When the stars twinkle at night, it floats up from the sea floor, and its body's center core flickers.

121.name: Starmie
121.dex: It is said that it uses the sevencolored core of its body to send electric waves into outer space.

122.name: Mr. Mime
122.dex: It uses the mysterious power it has in its fingers to solidify air into an invisible wall.

123.name: Scyther
123.dex: It's very proud of its speed. It moves so fast that its opponent does not even know what knocked it down.

124.name: Jynx
124.dex: It has several different cry patterns, each of which seems to have its own meaning.

125.name: Electabuzz
125.dex: When two ELECTABUZZ touch, they control the electric currents to communicate their feelings.

126.name: Magmar
126.dex: It moves more frequently in hot areas. It can heal itself by dipping its wound into lava.

127.name: Pinsir
127.dex: When the temperature drops at night, it sleeps on treetops or among roots where it is well hidden.

128.name: Tauros
128.dex: These violent Pokémon fight with other members of their herd in order to prove their strength.

129.name: Magikarp
129.dex: This weak and pathetic Pokémon gets easily pushed along rivers when there are strong currents.

130.name: Gyarados
130.dex: It appears whenever there is world conflict, burning down any place it travels through.

131.name: Lapras
131.dex: This gentle Pokémon loves to give people rides and provides a very comfortable way to get around.

132.name: Ditto
132.dex: When it encounters another DITTO, it will move faster than normal to duplicate that opponent exactly.

133.name: Eevee
133.dex: Its ability to evolve into many forms allows it to adapt smoothly and perfectly to any environment.

134.name: Vaporeon
134.dex: As it uses the fins on the tip of its tail to swim, it blends with the water perfectly.

135.name: Jolteon
135.dex: The negatively charged ions generated in its fur create a constant sparking noise.

136.name: Flareon
136.dex: Once it has stored up enough heat, this Pokémon's body temperature can reach up to 1700 degrees.

137.name: Porygon
137.dex: An artificial Pokémon created due to extensive research, it can perform only what is in its program.

138.name: Omanyte
138.dex: In prehistoric times, it swam on the sea floor, eating plankton. Its fossils are sometimes found.

139.name: Omastar
139.dex: Its heavy shell allowed it to reach only nearby food. This could be the reason it is extinct.

140.name: Kabuto
140.dex: Three hundred million years ago, it hid on the sea floor. It also has eyes on its back that glow.

141.name: Kabutops
141.dex: It was able to swim quickly through the water by compactly folding up its razor-sharp sickles.

142.name: Aerodactyl
142.dex: In prehistoric times, this Pokémon flew freely and fearlessly through the skies.

143.name: Snorlax
143.dex: This Pokémon's stomach is so strong, even eating moldy or rotten food will not affect it.

144.name: Articuno
144.dex: Legendary bird Pokémon. As it flies through the sky, it cools the air, causing snow to fall.

145.name: Zapdos
145.dex: Legendary bird Pokémon. They say lightning caused by the flapping of its wings causes summer storms.

146.name: Moltres
146.dex: Legendary bird Pokémon. It is said to migrate from the south along with the spring.

147.name: Dratini
147.dex: It sheds many layers of skin as it grows larger. During this process, it is protected by a rapid waterfall.

148.name: Dragonair
148.dex: It is called the divine Pokémon. When its entire body brightens slightly, the weather changes.

149.name: Dragonite
149.dex: It is said that somewhere in the ocean lies an island where these gather. Only they live there.

150.name: Mewtwo
150.dex: Said to rest quietly in an undiscovered cave, this Pokémon was created solely for battling.

151.name: Mew
151.dex: Because it can learn any move, some people began research to see if it is the ancestor of all Pokémon.

152.name: Chikorita
152.dex: It loves to bask in the sunlight. It uses the leaf on its head to seek out warm places.

153.name: Bayleef
153.dex: The scent that wafts from the leaves on its neck causes anyone who smells it to become energetic.

154.name: Meganium
154.dex: Anyone who stands beside it becomes refreshed, just as if they were relaxing in a sunny forest.

155.name: Cyndaquil
155.dex: The fire that spouts from its back burns hottest when it is angry. The flaring flames intimidate foes.

156.name: Quilava
156.dex: Before battle, it turns its back on its opponent to demonstrate how ferociously its fire blazes.

157.name: Typhlosion
157.dex: When heat from its body causes the air around it to shimmer, this is a sign that it is ready to battle.

158.name: Totodile
158.dex: This rough critter chomps at any moving object it sees. Turning your back on it is not recommended.

159.name: Croconaw
159.dex: The tips of its fangs are slanted backward. Once those fangs clamp down, the prey has no hope of escape.

160.name: Feraligatr
160.dex: Although it has a massive body, its powerful hind legs enable it to move quickly, even on the ground.

161.name: Sentret
161.dex: When acting as a lookout, it warns others of danger by screeching and hitting the ground with its tail.

162.name: Furret
162.dex: It lives in narrow burrows that fit its slim body. The deeper the nests go, the more mazelike they become.

163.name: Hoothoot
163.dex: It begins to hoot at the same time every day. Some trainers use them in place of clocks.

164.name: Noctowl
164.dex: Its extremely soft feathers make no sound in flight. It silently sneaks up on prey without being detected.

165.name: Ledyba
165.dex: It is timid and clusters together with others. The fluid secreted by its feet indicates its location.

166.name: Ledian
166.dex: In the daytime when it gets warm, it curls up inside a big leaf and drifts off into a deep slumber.

167.name: Spinarak
167.dex: If prey becomes ensnared in its nest of spun string, it waits motionlessly until it becomes dark.

168.name: Ariados
168.dex: Rather than making a nest in one specific spot, it wanders in search of food after darkness falls.

169.name: Crobat
169.dex: As a result of its pursuit of faster, yet more silent flight, a new set of wings grew on its hind legs.

170.name: Chinchou
170.dex: Its antennae, which evolved from a fin, have both positive and negative charges flowing through them.

171.name: Lanturn
171.dex: This Pokémon uses the bright part of its body, which changed from a dorsal fin, to lure prey.

172.name: Pichu
172.dex: It is unskilled at storing electric power. Any kind of shock causes it to discharge energy spontaneously.

173.name: Cleffa
173.dex: If the impact site of a meteorite is found, this Pokémon is certain to be within the immediate area.

174.name: Igglybuff
174.dex: Instead of walking with its short legs, it moves around by bouncing on its soft, tender body.

175.name: Togepi
175.dex: It is considered to be a symbol of good luck. Its shell is said to be filled with happiness.

176.name: Togetic
176.dex: Although it does not flap its wings very much, it can stay up in the air as it tags along after its trainer.

177.name: Natu
177.dex: It is extremely good at climbing tree trunks and likes to eat the new sprouts on the trees.

178.name: Xatu
178.dex: Once it begins to meditate at sunrise, the entire day will pass before it will move again.

179.name: Mareep
179.dex: It stores lots of air in its soft fur, allowing it to stay cool in summer and warm in winter.

180.name: Flaaffy
180.dex: Because of its rubbery, electricity-resistant skin, it can store lots of electricity in its fur.

181.name: Ampharos
181.dex: When it gets dark, the light from its bright, shiny tail can be seen from far away on the ocean's surface.

182.name: Bellossom
182.dex: When these dance together, their petals rub against each other, making pretty, relaxing sounds.

183.name: Marill
183.dex: The fur on its body naturally repels water. It can stay dry, even when it plays in the water.

184.name: Azumarill
184.dex: The bubble-like pattern on its stomach helps it camouflage itself when it's in the water.

185.name: Sudowoodo
185.dex: If a tree branch shakes when there is no wind, it's a SUDOWOODO, not a tree. It hides from the rain.

186.name: Politoed
186.dex: When it expands its throat to croak out a tune, nearby POLIWAG and POLIWHIRL gather immediately.

187.name: Hoppip
187.dex: It can be carried away on even the gentlest breeze. It may even float all the way to the next town.

188.name: Skiploom
188.dex: As soon as it rains, it closes its flower and hides in the shade of a tree to avoid getting wet.

189.name: Jumpluff
189.dex: Even in the fiercest wind, it can control its fluff to make its way to any place in the world it wants.

190.name: Aipom
190.dex: It uses its tail to hang on to tree branches. It uses its momentum to swing from one branch to another.

191.name: Sunkern
191.dex: It is very weak. Its only means of defense is to shake its leaves desperately at its attacker.

192.name: Sunflora
192.dex: As the hot season approaches, the petals on this Pokémon's face become more vivid and lively.

193.name: Yanma
193.dex: It can see in all directions without moving its big eyes, helping it spot attackers and food right away.

194.name: Wooper
194.dex: A mucous membrane covers its body. Touching it barehanded will cause a shooting pain.

195.name: Quagsire
195.dex: Its body is always slimy. It often bangs its head on the river bottom as it swims but seems not to care.

196.name: Espeon
196.dex: The tip of its forked tail quivers when it is predicting its opponent's next move.

197.name: Umbreon
197.dex: On the night of a full moon, or when it gets excited, the ring patterns on its body glow yellow.

198.name: Murkrow
198.dex: It hides any shiny object it finds in a secret location. MURKROW and MEOWTH loot one another's stashes.

199.name: Slowking
199.dex: Every time it yawns, SHELLDER injects more poison into it. The poison makes it more intelligent.

200.name: Misdreavus
200.dex: It loves to watch people it's scared. It frightens them by screaming loudly or appearing suddenly.

201.name: Unown
201.dex: Because different types of UNOWN exist, it is said that they must have a variety of abilities.

202.name: Wobbuffet
202.dex: In order to conceal its black tail, it lives in a dark cave and only moves about at night.

203.name: Girafarig
203.dex: When it is in danger, its tail uses some sort of mysterious powers to drive away the enemy.

204.name: Pineco
204.dex: It spits out a fluid that it uses to glue tree bark to its body. The fluid hardens when it touches air.

205.name: Forretress
205.dex: Usually found hanging on to a fat tree trunk. It shoots out bits of its shell when it sees action.

206.name: Dunsparce
206.dex: It hides deep inside caves where no light ever reaches it and remains virtually motionless there.

207.name: Gligar
207.dex: It builds its nest on a steep cliff. When it is done gliding, it hops along the ground back to its nest.

208.name: Steelix
208.dex: The many small metal particles that cover this Pokémon's body reflect bright light well.

209.name: Snubbull
209.dex: In truth, it is a cowardly Pokémon. It growls eagerly in order to hide its fear from its opponent.

210.name: Granbull
210.dex: It can make most any Pokémon run away simply by opening its mouth wide to reveal its big fangs.

211.name: Qwilfish
211.dex: When faced with a larger opponent, it swallows as much water as it can to match the opponent's size.

212.name: Scizor
212.dex: This Pokémon's pincers, which contain steel, can crush any hard object it gets a hold of into bits.

213.name: Shuckle
213.dex: The fluid secreted by its toes carves holes in rocks for nesting and can be mixed with BERRIES to make a drink.

214.name: Heracross
214.dex: With its Herculean powers, it can easily throw around an object that is 100 times its own weight.

215.name: Sneasel
215.dex: This cunning Pokémon hides under the cover of darkness, waiting to attack its prey.

216.name: Teddiursa
216.dex: It always licks honey. Its palm tastes sweet because of all the honey it has absorbed.

217.name: Ursaring
217.dex: Although it has a large body, it is quite skilled at climbing trees. It eats and sleeps in the treetops.

218.name: Slugma
218.dex: These group together in areas that are hotter than normal. If it cools off, its skin hardens.

219.name: Magcargo
219.dex: Its body is as hot as lava and is always billowing. Flames will occasionally burst from its shell.

220.name: Swinub
220.dex: It uses the tip of its nose to dig for food. Its nose is so tough that even frozen ground poses no problem.

221.name: Piloswine
221.dex: Although its legs are short, its rugged hooves prevent it from slipping, even on icy ground.

222.name: Corsola
222.dex: The points on its head absorb nutrients from clean water. They cannot survive in polluted water.

223.name: Remoraid
223.dex: To escape from an attacker, it may shoot water out of its mouth, then use that force to swim backward.

224.name: Octillery
224.dex: Its instinct is to bury itself in holes. It often steals the nesting holes of others to sleep in them.

225.name: Delibird
225.dex: It always carries its food with it, wherever it goes. If attacked, it throws its food at the opponent.

226.name: Mantine
226.dex: It swims along freely, eating things that swim into its mouth. Its whole body is very coarse.

227.name: Skarmory
227.dex: The feathers that it sheds are very sharp. It is said that people once used the feathers as swords.

228.name: Houndour
228.dex: Around dawn, its ominous howl echoes through the area to announce that this is its territory.

229.name: Houndoom
229.dex: The pungentsmelling flame that shoots from its mouth results from toxins burning in its body.

230.name: Kingdra
230.dex: It stores energy by sleeping at underwater depths at which no other life forms can survive.

231.name: Phanpy
231.dex: During the deserted morning hours, it comes ashore where it deftly uses its trunk to take a shower.

232.name: Donphan
232.dex: Because this Pokémon's skin is so tough, a normal attack won't even leave a scratch on it.

233.name: Porygon2
233.dex: This manmade Pokémon evolved from the latest technology. It may have unprogrammed reactions.

234.name: Stantler
234.dex: The round balls found on the fallen antlers can be ground into a powder that aids in sleeping.

235.name: Smeargle
235.dex: The color of the mysterious fluid secreted from its tail is predetermined for each SMEARGLE.

236.name: Tyrogue
236.dex: To brush up on its fighting skills, it will challenge anyone. It has a very strong competitive spirit.

237.name: Hitmontop
237.dex: After doing a handstand to throw off the opponent's timing, it presents its fancy kick moves.

238.name: Smoochum
238.dex: The sensitivity of its lips develops most quickly. It uses them to try to identify unknown objects.

239.name: Elekid
239.dex: It loves violent thunder. The space between its horns flickers bluishwhite when it is charging energy.

240.name: Magby
240.dex: It naturally spits an 1100-degree flame. It is said when many appear, it heralds a volcanic eruption.

241.name: Miltank
241.dex: In order to milk a MILTANK, one must have a knack for rhythmically pulling up and down on its udders.

242.name: Blissey
242.dex: Biting into one of the delicious eggs that BLISSEY provides will make everyone around smile with joy.

243.name: Raikou
243.dex: This rough Pokémon stores energy inside its body, then sweeps across the land, shooting off electricity.

244.name: Entei
244.dex: This brawny Pokémon courses around the earth, spouting flames hotter than a volcano's magma.

245.name: Suicune
245.dex: This divine Pokémon blows around the world, always in search of a pure reservoir.

246.name: Larvitar
246.dex: Born deep underground, this Pokémon becomes a pupa after eating enough dirt to make a mountain.

247.name: Pupitar
247.dex: It will not stay still, even while it's a pupa. It already has arms and legs under its solid shell.

248.name: Tyranitar
248.dex: In just one of its mighty hands, it has the power to make the ground shake and mountains crumble.

249.name: Lugia
249.dex: It has an incredible ability to calm raging storms. It is said that LUGIA appears when storms start.

250.name: Ho-Oh
250.dex: It will reveal itself before a pure-hearted trainer by shining its bright rainbow-colored wings.

251.name: Celebi
251.dex: Revered as a guardian of the forest, CELEBI appears wherever beautiful forests exist.

252.name: Treecko
252.dex: It makes its nest in a giant tree in the forest. It ferociously guards against anything nearing its territory. It is said to be the protector of the forest’s trees.

253.name: Grovyle
253.dex: Leaves grow out of this Pokémon’s body. They help obscure a GROVYLE from the eyes of its enemies while it is in a thickly overgrown forest.

254.name: Sceptile
254.dex: In the jungle, its power is without equal. This Pokémon carefully grows trees and plants. It regulates its body temperature by basking in sunlight.

255.name: Torchic
255.dex: If attacked, it strikes back by spitting balls of fire it forms in its stomach. A TORCHIC dislikes darkness because it can’t see its surroundings.

256.name: Combusken
256.dex: It lashes out with 10 kicks per second. Its strong fighting instinct compels it to keep up its offensive until the opponent gives up.

257.name: Blaziken
257.dex: It learns martial arts that use punches and kicks. Every several years, its old feathers burn off, and new, supple feathers grow back in their place.

258.name: Mudkip
258.dex: On land, it can powerfully lift large boulders by planting its four feet and heaving. It sleeps by burying itself in soil at the water’s edge.

259.name: Marshtomp
259.dex: Its toughened hind legs enable it to stand upright. Because it weakens if its skin dries out, it replenishes fluids by playing in mud.

260.name: Swampert
260.dex: If it senses the approach of a storm and a tidal wave, it protects its seaside nest by piling up boulders. It swims as fast as a jet ski.

261.name: Poochyena
261.dex: It savagely threatens foes with bared fangs. It chases after fleeing targets tenaciously. It turns tail and runs, however, if the foe strikes back.

262.name: Mightyena
262.dex: In the wild, MIGHTYENA live in a pack. They never defy their leader’s orders. They defeat foes with perfectly coordinated teamwork.

263.name: Zigzagoon
263.dex: Rubbing its nose against the ground, it always wanders about back and forth in search of something. It is distinguished by the zigzag footprints it leaves.

264.name: Linoone
264.dex: It is exceedingly fast if it only has to run in a straight line. When it spots ponddwelling prey underwater, it quickly leaps in and catches it with its sharp claws.

265.name: Wurmple
265.dex: It sticks to tree branches and eats leaves. The thread it spits from its mouth, which becomes gooey when it touches air, slows the movement of its foes.

266.name: Silcoon
266.dex: It prepares for evolution using the energy it stored while it was a WURMPLE. It keeps watch over the surroundings with its two eyes.

267.name: Beautifly
267.dex: Its colorfully patterned wings are its most prominent feature. It flies through flower-covered fields collecting pollen. It attacks ferociously when angered.

268.name: Cascoon
268.dex: To avoid detection by its enemies, it hides motionlessly beneath large leaves and in the gaps of branches. It also attaches dead leaves to its body for camouflage.

269.name: Dustox
269.dex: It is a nocturnal Pokémon that flies from fields and mountains to the attraction of streetlights at night. It looses highly toxic powder from its wings.

270.name: Lotad
270.dex: This Pokémon lives in ponds with clean water. It is known to ferry small Pokémon across ponds by carrying them on the broad leaf on its head.

271.name: Lombre
271.dex: In the evening, it takes great delight in popping out of rivers and startling people. It feeds on aquatic moss that grows on rocks in the riverbed.

272.name: Ludicolo
272.dex: When it hears festive music, all the cells in its body become stimulated, and it begins moving in rhythm. It does not quail even when it faces a tough opponent.

273.name: Seedot
273.dex: It hangs off branches and absorbs nutrients. When it finishes eating, its body becomes so heavy that it drops to the ground with a thump.

274.name: Nuzleaf
274.dex: A forest-dwelling Pokémon that is skilled at climbing trees. Its long and pointed nose is its weak point. It loses power if the nose is gripped.

275.name: Shiftry
275.dex: It is said to arrive on chilly, wintry winds. Feared from long ago as the guardian of forests, this Pokémon lives in a deep forest where people do not venture.

276.name: Taillow
276.dex: Although it is small, it is very courageous. It will take on a larger SKARMORY on an equal footing. However, its will weakens if it becomes hungry.

277.name: Swellow
277.dex: A SWELLOW dives upon prey from far above. It never misses its targets. It takes to the skies in search of lands with a warm climate.

278.name: Wingull
278.dex: It makes its nest on a sheer cliff at the edge of the sea. It has trouble keeping its wings flapping in flight. Instead, it soars on updrafts.

279.name: Pelipper
279.dex: It skims the tops of waves as it flies. When it spots prey, it uses its large beak to scoop up the victim with water. It protects its eggs in its beak.

280.name: Ralts
280.dex: A RALTS has the power to sense the emotions of people and Pokémon with the horns on its head. It takes cover if it senses any hostility.

281.name: Kirlia
281.dex: A KIRLIA has the psychic power to create a rip in the dimensions and see into the future. It is said to dance with pleasure on sunny mornings.

282.name: Gardevoir
282.dex: It apparently does not feel the pull of gravity because it supports itself with psychic power. It will give its life to protect its TRAINER.

283.name: Surskit
283.dex: They gather on puddles after evening downpours, gliding across the surface of water as if sliding. It secretes honey with a sweet aroma from its head.

284.name: Masquerain
284.dex: It intimidates foes with the large eyelike patterns on its antennae. Because it can’t fly if its wings get wet, it shelters itself from rain under large trees and eaves.

285.name: Shroomish
285.dex: It loves to eat damp, composted soil in forests. If you enter a forest after a long rain, you can see many SHROOMISH feasting on composted soil.

286.name: Breloom
286.dex: It scatters spores from holes in the cap on its head. It loves warm and humid climates. It feeds on trees and plants in fields and forests.

287.name: Slakoth
287.dex: It sleeps virtually all day and night long. It doesn’t change its nest its entire life, but it sometimes travels great distances by swimming in rivers.

288.name: Vigoroth
288.dex: It can’t keep still because its blood boils with energy. It runs through the fields and mountains all day to calm itself. If it doesn’t, it can’t sleep at night.

289.name: Slaking
289.dex: Hordes of SLAKING gather around trees when fruits come into season. They wait around patiently for ripened fruits to fall out of the trees.

290.name: Nincada
290.dex: It makes its nest at the roots of a mighty tree. Using its whiskerlike antennae, it probes its surroundings in the pitch-black darkness of soil.

291.name: Ninjask
291.dex: Because it darts about vigorously at high speed, it is very difficult to see. Hearing its distinctive cries for too long induces a headache.

292.name: Shedinja
292.dex: A peculiar Pokémon that floats in air even though its wings remain completely still. The inside of its body is hollow and utterly dark.

293.name: Whismur
293.dex: Its cries equal a jet plane in volume. It inhales through its ear canals. Because of this system, it can cry continually without having to catch its breath.

294.name: Loudred
294.dex: It positions the round speakers on its head to assail foes with ultrasonic waves at massive volume. It builds power by stomping the ground.

295.name: Exploud
295.dex: It has sound-generating organs all over its body. It communicates with others by adjusting the tone and volume of the cries it emits.

296.name: Makuhita
296.dex: It loves to toughen up its body above all else. If you hear quaking rumbles in a cave, it is the sound of MAKUHITA undertaking strenuous training.

297.name: Hariyama
297.dex: It has the habit of challenging others without hesitation to tests of strength. It’s been known to stand on train tracks and stop trains using forearm thrusts.

298.name: Azurill
298.dex: Its tail, which is packed with nutrition, is very bouncy like a rubber ball. On sunny days they gather at the edge of water and splash about for fun.

299.name: Nosepass
299.dex: Its body emits a powerful magnetism. It feeds on prey that is pulled in by the force. Its magnetism is stronger in cold seasons.

300.name: Skitty
300.dex: A SKITTY’s adorably cute behavior makes it highly popular. In battle, it makes its tail puff out. It threatens foes with a sharp growl.

301.name: Delcatty
301.dex: Rather than keeping a permanent lair, it habitually seeks comfortable spots and sleeps there. It is nocturnal and becomes active at dusk.

302.name: Sableye
302.dex: It digs branching holes in caves using its sharp claws in search of food--raw gems. A SABLEYE lurks in darkness and is seen only rarely.

303.name: Mawile
303.dex: Its giant jaws are actually steel horns that transformed. It fools foes into complacency with its adorable gestures, then chomps them with its huge jaws.

304.name: Aron
304.dex: A Pokémon that is clad in steel armor. A new suit of armor is made when it evolves. The old, discarded armor is salvaged as metal for making iron products.

305.name: Lairon
305.dex: When two LAIRON meet in the wild, they fight for territory by bashing into each other with their steel bodies. The sound of their collision carries for miles.

306.name: Aggron
306.dex: Its iron horns grow longer a little at a time. They are used to determine the AGGRON’s age. The gouges in its armor are worn with pride as mementos from battles.

307.name: Meditite
307.dex: It continually meditates for hours every day. As a result of rigorous and dedicated yoga training, it has tempered its spiritual power so much it can fly.

308.name: Medicham
308.dex: Through crushingly harsh yoga training, it gained the power to foretell its foe’s actions. It battles with elegant, dancelike movement.

309.name: Electrike
309.dex: It generates electricity using friction from the atmosphere. In seasons with especially arid air, its entire body blazes with violent showers of sparks.

310.name: Manectric
310.dex: Because lightning falls in their vicinities, MANECTRIC were thought to have been born from lightning. In battle, they create thunderclouds.

311.name: Plusle
311.dex: It has the trait of cheering on its fellow Pokémon. By shorting out the electricity it releases from its paws, it creates pom-poms for cheering.

312.name: Minun
312.dex: At a meeting of Pokémon academics, it was announced that simultaneous exposure to electricity from a PLUSLE and MINUN will promote circulation and boost vitality.

313.name: Volbeat
313.dex: With their taillights lit, VOLBEAT fly in a swarm, drawing geometric designs in the night sky. They move their nests if their pond water becomes dirty.

314.name: Illumise
314.dex: A nocturnal Pokémon that becomes active upon nightfall. It leads a VOLBEAT swarm to draw patterns in the night sky. Over 200 different patterns have been confirmed.

315.name: Roselia
315.dex: A ROSELIA that drinks nutritionally rich springwater blooms with lovely flowers. The fragrance of its flowers has the effect of making its foes careless.

316.name: Gulpin
316.dex: This Pokémon’s stomach fluid can even digest scrap iron. In one gulp, it can swallow something that is as large as itself.

317.name: Swalot
317.dex: Its powerful stomach acid is capable of digesting almost anything. The one thing in the whole world a SWALOT can’t digest is its own stomach.

318.name: Carvanha
318.dex: CARVANHA attack ships in swarms, making them sink. Although it is said to be a very vicious Pokémon, it timidly flees as soon as it finds itself alone.

319.name: Sharpedo
319.dex: The vicious and sly gangster of the sea. Its skin is specially textured to minimize drag in water. Its speed tops out at over 75 miles per hour.

320.name: Wailmer
320.dex: While this Pokémon usually lives in the sea, it can survive on land, although not too long. It loses vitality if its body becomes dried out.

321.name: Wailord
321.dex: It breathes through nostrils that it raises above the sea. By inhaling to its maximum capacity, a WAILORD can dive close to 10,000 feet beneath the waves.

322.name: Numel
322.dex: A NUMEL stores boiling magma in the hump on its back. It is a hardy Pokémon that can transport a 220-pound load. It has served humans at work since long ago.

323.name: Camerupt
323.dex: A Pokémon that lives in the crater of a volcano. Every 10 years, the volcanoes on its back erupt violently. Research is under way on the cause of eruption.

324.name: Torkoal
324.dex: It battles using energy it gets from burning coal. When loosing smoke from its nostrils, it lets off a sound that is similar to a locomotive’s horn.

325.name: Spoink
325.dex: A Pokémon that manipulates psychic power at will. It doesn’t stop bouncing even when it is asleep. It loves eating mushrooms that grow underground.

326.name: Grumpig
326.dex: It stores power in the black pearls on its forehead. When it uses psychic power, it performs an odd dance step. Its style of dancing became hugely popular overseas.

327.name: Spinda
327.dex: It is distinguished by a pattern of spots that is always different. Its unsteady, tottering walk has the effect of fouling its foe’s aim.

328.name: Trapinch
328.dex: Its big jaws crunch through boulders. Because its head is so big, it has a hard time getting back upright if it tips over onto its back.

329.name: Vibrava
329.dex: It looses ultrasonic waves by rubbing its wings together. Since a VIBRAVA’s wings are still in the process of growing, it can only fly short distances.

330.name: Flygon
330.dex: The flapping of its wings sounds like singing. To prevent detection by enemies, it hides itself by flapping up a cloud of desert sand.

331.name: Cacnea
331.dex: CACNEA live in deserts with virtually no rainfall. It battles by swinging its thick, spiked arms. Once a year, a yellow flower blooms.

332.name: Cacturne
332.dex: After spending thousands of years in harsh deserts, its blood transformed into the same substances as sand. It is nocturnal, so it hunts at night.

333.name: Swablu
333.dex: A Pokémon that has wings like cottony clouds. After enduring winter, in which little food is available, SWABLU flocks move closer to towns in the spring.

334.name: Altaria
334.dex: It hums in a beautiful soprano voice. It flies among white clouds in the blue sky. It launches intensely hot fireballs from its mouth.

335.name: Zangoose
335.dex: When it battles, it stands on its hind legs and attacks with its sharply clawed forelegs. Its fur bristles if it encounters any SEVIPER.

336.name: Seviper
336.dex: SEVIPER and ZANGOOSE are eternal rivals. It counters a ZANGOOSE’s dazzling agility with its swordlike tail, which also oozes a horrible poison.

337.name: Lunatone
337.dex: It becomes very active on the night of a full moon. This Pokémon was first discovered 40 years ago at the site of a meteor strike.

338.name: Solrock
338.dex: Solar energy is the source of this Pokémon’s power. On sunny days, groups of SOLROCK line up facing the sun and absorb its light.

339.name: Barboach
339.dex: Its body is covered with a slimy film. The film acts as a barrier to prevent germs in muddy water from entering the BARBOACH’s body.

340.name: Whiscash
340.dex: Mysteriously, it can foretell earthquakes. In the daytime, it sleeps in mud at the bottom of a pond. When it awakens, it continually feeds throughout the night.

341.name: Corphish
341.dex: Once it grips prey with its large pincers, it will never let go, no matter what. It is a hardy Pokémon that can thrive in any environment.

342.name: Crawdaunt
342.dex: A brutish Pokémon that loves to battle. A veteran CRAWDAUNT that has prevailed in hundreds of battles has giant pincers marked with countless scars.

343.name: Baltoy
343.dex: A BALTOY moves by spinning on its single foot. It has been depicted in murals adorning the walls of a once-bustling city in an ancient age.

344.name: Claydol
344.dex: A CLAYDOL sleeps while hovering in midair. Its arms are separate from its body. They are kept floating by the Pokémon’s manipulation of psychic power.

345.name: Lileep
345.dex: It disguises itself as seaweed by making its tentacles sway. Unsuspecting prey that come too close are swallowed whole. It became extinct 100 million years ago.

346.name: Cradily
346.dex: It drags its heavy body along the seafloor. It makes its nest in the shallows of warm seas. CRADILY can be seen on beaches when the tide goes out.

347.name: Anorith
347.dex: It was resurrected from a fossil using the power of science. It swims by undulating the eight wings at its sides. They were feet that adapted to life in the sea.

348.name: Armaldo
348.dex: ARMALDO usually lives on land. However, when it hunts for prey, it dives beneath the ocean. It swims around using its two large wings.

349.name: Feebas
349.dex: FEEBAS live in ponds that are heavily infested with weeds. Because of its hopelessly shabby appearance, it seems as if few TRAINERS raise it.

350.name: Milotic
350.dex: It is said to live at the bottom of large lakes. Considered to be the most beautiful of all Pokémon, it has been depicted in paintings and statues.

351.name: Castform
351.dex: It alters its form depending on the weather. Changes in the climate such as the temperature and humidity appear to affect its cellular structure.

352.name: Kecleon
352.dex: A Pokémon that has the ability to alter its body colors to match its surroundings. A KECLEON reverts to its original colors if it is startled.

353.name: Shuppet
353.dex: This Pokémon roams about deep in the night seeking such negative emotions as grudges and envy. It retreats to its nest when the sun begins to rise.

354.name: Banette
354.dex: An abandoned plush doll became this Pokémon. They are said to live in garbage dumps and wander about in search of the children that threw them away.

355.name: Duskull
355.dex: A glare from its single scarlet eye makes even burly grown-ups freeze in utter fear. It is a nocturnal Pokémon that roams about under the cloak of darkness.

356.name: Dusclops
356.dex: It is thought that its body is hollow with only a spectral ball of fire burning inside. However, no one has been able to confirm this theory as fact.

357.name: Tropius
357.dex: It flies by flapping its broad leaves. The bunch of fruit that grows around its neck is deliciously sweet. In the spring, it scatters pollen from its neck.

358.name: Chimecho
358.dex: They fly about very actively when the hot season arrives. They communicate among themselves using seven different and distinguishing cries.

359.name: Absol
359.dex: It sharply senses even subtle changes in the sky and the land to predict natural disasters. It is a long-lived Pokémon that has a life-span of 100 years.

360.name: Wynaut
360.dex: A WYNAUT loves to eat sweet fruits. It cleverly picks fruits using its earlike arms. They gather in fruit gardens, drawn by the fragrance.

361.name: Snorunt
361.dex: They tend to move about in groups of around five SNORUNT. In snowy regions, it is said that when they are seen late at night, snowfall will arrive by morning.

362.name: Glalie
362.dex: A GLALIE has the power to instantaneously freeze moisture in the atmosphere. A dazzling cloud of diamondlike ice crystals forms around its body.

363.name: Spheal
363.dex: It is completely covered with plushy fur. As a result, it never feels the cold even when it is rolling about on ice floes or diving in the sea.

364.name: Sealeo
364.dex: SEALEO live in herds on ice floes. Using its powerful flippers, it shatters ice. It dives into the sea to hunt prey five times a day.

365.name: Walrein
365.dex: To protect its herd, the leader battles anything that invades its territory, even at the cost of its life. Its tusks may snap off in battle.

366.name: Clamperl
366.dex: A CLAMPERL slams its shell closed on prey to prevent escape. The pearl it creates upon evolution is said to be infused with a mysterious energy.

367.name: Huntail
367.dex: To withstand the crushing pressure of water deep under the sea, its spine is very thick and sturdy. Its tail, which is shaped like a small fish, has eyes that light up.

368.name: Gorebyss
368.dex: A GOREBYSS siphons the body fluids of prey through its thin, tubular mouth. Its light pink body color turns vivid when it finishes feeding.

369.name: Relicanth
369.dex: A Pokémon that was once believed to have been extinct. The species has not changed its form for 100 million years. It walks on the seafloor using its pectoral fins.

370.name: Luvdisc
370.dex: LUVDISC make the branches of CORSOLA their nests. There is a custom from long ago of giving a LUVDISC as a gift to express one’s feelings of love.

371.name: Bagon
371.dex: Although it is small, this Pokémon is very powerful because its body is a bundle of muscles. It launches head-butts with its ironlike skull.

372.name: Shelgon
372.dex: It hardly eats while it awaits evolution. It becomes hardier by enduring hunger. Its shell peels off the instant it begins to evolve.

373.name: Salamence
373.dex: After many long years, its cellular structure underwent a sudden mutation to grow wings. When angered, it loses all thought and rampages out of control.

374.name: Beldum
374.dex: When BELDUM gather in a swarm, they move in perfect unison as if they were but one Pokémon. They communicate with each other using brain waves.

375.name: Metang
375.dex: The claws tipping its arms pack the destructive power to tear through thick iron sheets as if they were silk. It flies at over 60 miles per hour.

376.name: Metagross
376.dex: METAGROSS has four brains that are joined by a complex neural network. As a result of integration, this Pokémon is smarter than a supercomputer.

377.name: Regirock
377.dex: A Pokémon that is made entirely of rocks and boulders. If parts of its body chip off in battle, REGIROCK repairs itself by adding new rocks.

378.name: Regice
378.dex: Its entire body is made of Antarctic ice. After extensive studies, researchers believe the ice was formed during an ice age.

379.name: Registeel
379.dex: Its body is harder than any other kind of metal. The body metal is composed of a mysterious substance. Not only is it hard, it shrinks and stretches flexibly.

380.name: Latias
380.dex: They make a small herd of only several members. They rarely make contact with people or other Pokémon. They disappear if they sense enemies.

381.name: Latios
381.dex: Even in hiding, it can detect the locations of others and sense their emotions since it has telepathy. Its intelligence allows it to understand human languages.

382.name: Kyogre
382.dex: KYOGRE has appeared in mythology as the creator of the sea. After long years of feuding with GROUDON, it took to sleep at the bottom of the sea.

383.name: Groudon
383.dex: GROUDON has appeared in mythology as the creator of the land. It sleeps in magma underground and is said to make volcanoes erupt on awakening.

384.name: Rayquaza
384.dex: A Pokémon that flies endlessly in the ozone layer. It is said it would descend to the ground if KYOGRE and GROUDON were to fight.

385.name: Jirachi
385.dex: JIRACHI is said to make wishes come true. While it sleeps, a tough crystalline shell envelops the body to protect it from enemies.

386.name: Deoxys
386.dex: A Pokémon that mutated from an extraterrestrial virus exposed to a laser beam. Its body is configured for superior agility and speed.
